en: Distribute this version under the Prism Desk Non-Commercial License instead of MIT. Commercial use requires separate written authorization from the relevant copyright holders.

Make the non-commercial restriction visible in the introduction and license section of all nine README languages and in package metadata. Third-party licenses and the terms attached to previously distributed copies remain unchanged.
zh: 本版本改用棱镜非商业使用许可证，不再采用 MIT。未经相关著作权人另行书面授权，禁止商用。
九种语言的 README 简介、许可证章节及软件包元数据同步注明非商业限制。第三方许可证及此前已分发副本所附的许可条款不变。
